title: Firebase Firestore Small Examples
description: Use these small Firebase Firestore examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Meet collections and documents
examples.description: A collection groups documents. Each document has an id and named fields, such as a book title and page count.
examples.output: This worked model describes the document at books/moon-trip. The wrapper is an explanation, not an SDK write command.

examples.title: Start a local emulator
examples.description: An emulator imitates the service on your own computer.
examples.code:
npx firebase-tools init emulators
npx firebase-tools emulators:start --only firestore --project demo-reading-club
examples.output: After choosing Firestore during setup, the local emulator starts. Configure its rules file for the sample books collection.

examples.title: Write a named document
examples.description: setDoc writes fields at a document path you choose.
examples.output: With local rules allowing the sample write, books/moon-trip contains the two fields.

examples.title: Read one document
examples.description: getDoc reads a document snapshot. Check exists before reading fields, because the requested document may not be there.
examples.output: After the write lesson, this prints Moon Trip. A missing document prints the fallback.

examples.title: Let Firestore choose an id
examples.description: addDoc adds a document to a collection with an automatically made id.
examples.output: A new local sample document is created, and its generated id is logged.

examples.title: Change selected fields
examples.description: updateDoc changes named fields while leaving other fields alone.
examples.output: The existing moon-trip document keeps its title and changes pages to 64.

examples.title: Ask for matching documents
examples.description: A query applies a rule to a collection. getDocs returns snapshots for documents that match that rule.
examples.output: Only local books with pages at least 50 are returned.

examples.title: Sort and limit a query
examples.description: orderBy sorts query results by a field. limit caps how many documents are returned.
examples.output: At most two documents are returned, from the smallest page counts upward.

examples.title: Listen for local updates
examples.description: onSnapshot sends the current result and later changes.
examples.output: The callback receives the current document and later allowed updates while listening.

examples.title: Group writes in a batch
examples.description: A write batch applies several writes together.
examples.output: Both local sample books are written together when the rules allow both writes.

examples.title: Keep local practice rules narrow
examples.description: Security rules decide which client reads and writes are allowed.
examples.output: In the emulator, anyone using this demo client can read the books and write valid sample fields. Other collection access remains denied.

examples.title: Treat stored data as input
examples.description: A database record can have a shape your UI does not expect.
examples.output: The first line describes the book, and the second gives an incomplete-data message.
